positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationSettled
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration established, verified, and recorded as settled?
positions.why: All three expressions concern the same calibration fact: src-1 asserts it as completed at 88.4 MHz, src-2 claims verification against June reference plates across the full band, and src-3 records it as a key decision. They share technical register, competence appeal, and realis stance. The conviction gradient between claim (src-1, src-2) and decision (src-3) is tension the frame holds — the calibration is both asserted as fact by the lead astronomer and ratified as a settled outcome in the summary record.
